name: 10 Authentication — Mode switching between sign in, register, and recovery

planSteps.description: Navigate to /auth.html and wait for the authentication panel to load
Verify the sign-in form is visible with email and password fields
Verify the register form with confirm password field is visible
Click the 'Sign in' tab button, then click 'Forgot your password?'
Verify the recovery form is visible with 'Send recovery link ↗' button
